context: Asuka lectures on human dependence and society.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: sociology lecture; vocabulary (世の中/性格/実感/依存/根本) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世の中は、互いに依存して成り立ちます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 依存は、悪いことなんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 根本では、支え合いでもあります。
lines.en: At its root, it's also mutual support.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人の性格も、関係しますか?
lines.en: Does a person's character relate to it?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、性格が、関わり方を左右します。
lines.en: Yes, character shapes how we relate.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 頭では分かっても、実感が難しいです。
lines.en: I understand it in my head, but feeling it is hard.
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日々の中で、実感は深まります。
lines.en: In daily life, that sense deepens.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 世の中の根本が、見えた気がします。
lines.en: I feel I glimpsed society's root.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
